note: Per-module draft (P059). P058 merges this into params.json. Every number carries its source; 'uzman varsayımı' = expert assumption, to be revisited.

correlation.source: PLACEHOLDER — uzman varsayımı; P052/P053 learns Corr(z_S, z_B, z_D | x) from SBD meets (docs/03-ML-MODEL.md §4.4) and replaces this matrix.

residual.min_variables_source: uzman varsayımı — with only two lifts the residual cannot tell which lift is off; the squat_deadlift rule covers that case.
residual.severity_sd_source: mild = 1.0 SD from docs/03-ML-MODEL.md §10 ('fark 1 standart sapmayı aşarsa'); moderate/severe = uzman varsayımı.

aggregation.confidence_weights_source: uzman varsayımı (§8 weights scores by movement confidence; values not yet fitted).

gate.source: docs/03-ML-MODEL.md §6 (machine/cable loads not comparable) + prompt P059 (only medium/high confidence).

ratio_rules.source: uzman varsayımı — equal z means the pair is balanced relative to the same population; a 1.0 z gap is about 1.1 SD of the difference at r = 0.6.

left_right.source: mild = 10% inter-limb asymmetry, the commonly used threshold reviewed in Bishop, Turner & Read (2018), J Sports Sci 36(10):1135-1144; moderate/severe = uzman varsayımı. Asymmetry = (strong - weak) / strong on e1RM kg of the same exercise.
